name: AWS EKS Terraform Lab
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip jq curl wget && echo 'Installing kind...' && curl -Lo /usr/local/bin/kind https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/dl/v0.20.0/kind-linux-amd64 && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/kind && echo 'Installing yq...' && curl -sL https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/latest/download/yq_linux_amd64 -o /usr/local/bin/yq && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq && echo 'Installing flux...' && curl -sL https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/releases/latest/download/flux_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz -C /usr/local/bin && echo 'Tools installed successfully'
